tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the full Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass without any code modifications.
2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/App.test.tsx to understand what is being tested.
3. FILES: No files to modify — this is a read-only validation task.
4. APPROACH: Run `npx vitest run` from the project root to execute all test files. Check exit code. If tests fail, report which tests failed and why without modifying any code.
5. PATTERNS: Test files follow the pattern `*.test.tsx` in `src/` and `src/components/`. The test setup file is at `src/test/setup.ts`.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0
All test files pass: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
Zero failing tests reported in the output
No TypeScript compilation errors during test run
